Monthly payment on a standard student loan plan

Source: R/monthly_standard_payment.R
monthly_standard_payment.Rd

mortgage_payment() with federal student loan defaults: 6.5% over 10 years. From the Managing debt chapter.

Usage

monthly_standard_payment(principal, annual_rate = 0.065, years = 10)

Arguments

principal

Loan amount.

annual_rate

Yearly interest rate, as a decimal. Defaults to 0.065.

years

Repayment term in years. Defaults to 10.

Value

A numeric vector of monthly payments.

See also

Other managing debt: apr_to_apy(), credit_utilization(), dti_ratio(), idr_monthly_payment(), loan_income_ratio(), months_to_payoff(), order_avalanche(), order_snowball(), payoff_vs_invest(), total_interest()

Examples

# standard 10-year monthly payment on $45,000
monthly_standard_payment(principal = 45000)
#> [1] 510.9659
